title: The Most Disturbing Things Nature Kept Trapped the Longest

thumbnail_brief: A dark layered Siberian permafrost cutaway with tiny Doug (red cap on, alive, looking up) in a small sealed pocket next to a huge magnified curled nematode that is clearly awake, a red arrow on the worm and the label IT WOKE UP, so the title promises the long trap and the thumbnail pays off that something came back out (no TRAPPED, NATURE, LONGEST, THINGS or DISTURBING on the image; worm in permafrost, never seafloor mud).
description:
What are the longest things nature has ever kept trapped? Doug is sealed into a cave, a glacier, a flooded pit, Siberian permafrost and the deep seafloor, each trap holding on longer than the last, from 27 hours to 101.5 million years, and some of what comes back out is still alive.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
